title: Kuratowski's Theorem: Planarity via Forbidden Minors (OQ-01-OQ-04)
description: Formalizes Kuratowski's theorem (1930): a finite graph is planar iff it contains no subdivision of K₅ or K₃,₃. Includes Wagner's equivalent minor characterization. Proves: graph minor relation is reflexive and transitive, K₅ and K₃,₃ edge counts, planarity implies degree bounds and coloring bounds. 12 axioms for the characterization iff; structural consequences proved. 29 theorems.
